subtitle: Deep-dive analysis of songs through music theory - understand every section's role and construction.

columns.title: Section-by-Section
columns.text: Each song section serves a specific purpose. Learn how intros, verses, choruses, and outros contribute to the musical journey.

columns.title: Theory in Practice
columns.text: See how theoretical concepts like chord progressions, scales, and song structure work together in real music.

topics.title: Intro Analysis
topics.description: Understand how intros establish key centers, set the mood, and introduce musical themes.

topics.title: Verse Analysis
topics.description: Learn how verses develop narratively while maintaining harmonic stability and melodic interest.

topics.title: Chorus Analysis
topics.description: Explore how choruses create emotional peaks through harmonic tension and melodic climax.

topics.title: Bridge Analysis
topics.description: Analyze how bridges provide contrast through key changes, new progressions, and melodic departure.

topics.title: Solo Analysis
topics.description: Break down solo construction, scale choices, and how leads interact with underlying progressions.

topics.title: Instrumental Breakdown
topics.description: Study instrumental sections and how they develop musical themes without vocal elements.

topics.title: Outro Analysis
topics.description: Understand different ending techniques and how they provide harmonic and emotional closure.

topics.title: Complete Song Analysis
topics.description: Full song breakdowns showing how all sections work together as a complete musical statement.

topics.title: We're Not Gonna Take It (Twisted Sister)
topics.description: Complete theory-based breakdown of this classic rock anthem with chord analysis and techniques.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Use the concepts in your own playing and compositions.
